## Executive Summary
Nikunj Garg is an India-based Java Backend Developer specializing in high-concurrency systems, Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL, Spring Security 6, and scalable RESTful API architectures. He is a BCA student at Shri Guru Ram Rai University (SGRRU, Dehradun), Secretary of TechMantra Coding Club, and builder of production-grade systems including AgriSathi AI and LibroSphere.

## Primary Technical Specializations
- **Programming Languages**: Java 21, SQL, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3
- **Backend Frameworks**: Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Spring Security 6, WebSockets (STOMP), REST APIs
- **Databases & Data Modeling**: PostgreSQL 15/16, relational normalization, schema indexing, ACID transactions, optimistic and pessimistic locking
- **Authentication & Security**: Stateless JWT authentication, Refresh Token Rotation (/auth/refresh), BCrypt password hashing, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- **DevOps, Cloud & Infrastructure**: Docker, Docker Compose, Git, GitHub, Railway, Maven, Postman, Thunder Client, Netlify
- **Testing & Quality Assurance**: JUnit 5, Mockito, multi-threaded concurrency stress testing using CountDownLatch and ExecutorService

## Major Projects

### 1. AgriSathi AI — Agricultural Intelligence & Decision Support
- **Overview**: 30-day hackathon AI agricultural intelligence backend supporting farmers with crop diagnosis and advisory.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, PostgreSQL, Spring Security, JWT, Computer Vision inference, Swagger 3.0.
- **Live Demo**: https://agri-sathi-ai-three.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/gargnikunj991-ux/AgriSathi_AI
- **Key Capabilities**: Multipart crop scan ingestion with computer vision disease classification, hyper-local agronomic weather engine, peer-to-peer agritech marketplace, and intelligent government scheme recommendations.

### 2. DevTinder — Real-Time Developer Matching Platform
- **Overview**: Teammate matchmaking backend engineered in 72 hours for Devlynix Buildathon 2.0.
- **Tech Stack**: Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL, Spring Security, WebSockets (STOMP), Railway Cloud Deployment.
- **Live Demo**: https://devlynix-frontend12-git-main-hxmblevishus-projects.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/gargnikunj991-ux/Devlynix-Buildathon-2.0.git
- **Key Capabilities**: Bidirectional STOMP WebSocket messaging broker, tech-stack compatibility matching algorithm, and normalized relational user profiles.

### 3. LibroSphere — High-Concurrency Asset Lending & FIFO Waitlist Engine
- **Overview**: Enterprise-grade asset lending engine built to eliminate race conditions and overselling under extreme contention.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, PostgreSQL, JUnit 5.
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/gargnikunj991-ux/library_spring.git
- **Key Capabilities**: Concurrency-safe atomic borrowing via PostgreSQL pessimistic write locks (`@Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)`), automated FIFO reservation queues with 48-hour pickup window allocation, and an automated 48-test JUnit 5 suite proving 0 oversells under 50-thread concurrent stress.
